calls.summary: Dr. Marcus Bell, a practice owner in Fort Worth, called to request a free practice appraisal and learn how the Private Practice Reimagined partnership model works. Agent Oscar walked him through the valuation process and the ongoing management fee structure, then booked a Start a Conversation consultation with the Business Development team. Dr. Bell was enthusiastic and confirmed his availability for the following week.

Dr. Priya Nair phoned from Oklahoma City about dentist partnership opportunities and whether she could retain clinical autonomy under the Apex model. Agent Lila explained the non-clinical support functions and the equity buy-in, then scheduled a partnership consultation with an Operations VP. Dr. Nair left the call reassured and looking forward to next steps.

Dr. Alan Voss, a supported dentist in Denver, called to explore the Dental Marketing Program for local SEO and patient-acquisition campaigns at his location. Agent Rosey outlined the website, paid ads, and reputation services, then booked a consultation with the marketing team. Dr. Voss was pleased with the clear pricing overview and confirmed the meeting.

Dr. Rachel Kim, a new prospect in Plano, called to schedule an introductory consultation about joining Apex and requested that someone collect her practice details. Agent Lee captured her practice name, location, provider count, annual production, and preferred contact times, then booked her Start a Conversation consultation. She confirmed her email and looked forward to the call with Business Development.

Dr. Thomas Reed called about Talent Acquisition and recruiting support to fill an open hygienist role at his Tulsa office. Agent Mary described the sourcing, onboarding, and retention services and booked a consultation to review his staffing gaps. Dr. Reed appreciated the fast follow-up and confirmed the meeting.

Dr. Helen Ortiz, a partnered dentist in Austin, called with a question about insurance credentialing timelines for a newly hired associate. Agent Sue confirmed the payer enrollment status and explained the re-credentialing steps but could not resolve one pending plan on the call. Dr. Ortiz was satisfied with the update though the credentialing issue remained open.

Dr. Samuel Grant followed up on a practice appraisal he had requested earlier and wanted to review the fair market valuation figures. Agent Mike clarified the numbers and, after answering his questions, scheduled a consultation with a transitions specialist. Dr. Grant remained slightly hesitant but agreed to the appraisal review meeting.

Dr. Karen Wu, an existing partner, called the support office about a discrepancy in her monthly Revenue Cycle and Accounting report and a credentialing charge she did not recognize. Agent Jennifer researched the AP entries but had to escalate the billing question to the accounting department. Dr. Wu was frustrated that no immediate answer was available.

Dr. Brian Fowler called Managed IT support because his practice-management software was down at the front desk during patient check-in. Agent Rose logged the outage and opened a ticket but the system was still not restored during the call. Dr. Fowler was clearly stressed about the impact on his schedule.

Nina Alvarez, an office manager at a supported practice, called about HR and Benefits Administration questions regarding a team member's 401K match and CE reimbursement. Agent Oscar explained the enrollment window but could not confirm one benefit detail without HR review. Nina was mildly annoyed at needing a callback.

Dr. Peter Shah called to ask why his AGD-accredited continuing education course reimbursement had not been processed for a PACE CE class he completed last quarter. Agent Lila found the request stuck in review and promised to escalate it. Dr. Shah was disappointed about the delay.

Dr. Laura Benson called to complain that her Dental Marketing Program results had not improved patient volume after three months at her location. Agent Lee reviewed the campaign metrics but Dr. Benson felt the marketing spend was not delivering. The call ended without a resolution and a manager callback was promised.

Dr. Gregory Lane called upset that a recruiting search for an associate dentist had dragged on far longer than expected and no candidates had been presented. Agent Sue apologized and checked the talent acquisition pipeline but had no candidate updates to share. Dr. Lane demanded a supervisor follow-up.

An unidentified caller from a Colorado practice reached the line after hours and left a voicemail asking about pausing services during a practice transition. The message rolled to voicemail with no agent available. No details beyond the callback number were captured.

Dr. Vincent Cole called to dispute a management fee on his latest statement and threatened to reconsider his partnership if it was not corrected. Agent Mary tried to explain the fee breakdown but Dr. Cole remained angry and refused the explanation. The billing dispute was escalated with no resolution on the call.

prompts.question: Is the customer trying to solve a specific problem?
prompts.answer: The practice owner is exploring practice transition options and wants to understand the fair market value of their multi-location dental practice. They are interested in maintaining the private practice feel while accessing non-clinical support from a DSO partner.

prompts.question: What are the customer's expectations?
prompts.answer: The caller expects to learn about Apex's partnership model, understand how the valuation process works, and schedule a follow-up consultation to discuss transitioning their practice.

prompts.question: How could the agent handle the call better?
prompts.answer: The agent should have captured the caller's email address and phone number to ensure proper follow-up. Additionally, asking about current pain points in operations, staffing, or practice management would have qualified the lead more deeply before closing.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling Apex Dental Partners. This is Marcus Bell speaking. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Hi Marcus. My name is Dr. Jennifer Caldwell. I own a couple of dental practices in the Dallas area, and I heard about Apex through a colleague. I'm curious about how your partnership model works, especially the valuation process.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Wonderful to meet you, Dr. Caldwell. Thank you for reaching out. We work with practice owners just like you who are exploring their options. Can I ask, are you looking at transitioning your practice, or are you interested in learning more about our non-clinical support services?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Both, actually. I'm interested in understanding the partnership model better, and I'd like to know what a valuation of my practices might look like. We've been successful, but managing everything non-clinically takes time away from patient care.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: That makes a lot of sense. Many of our partners tell us the same thing. So you have two locations in Dallas, is that correct?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Yes, two locations in Dallas and one in Plano. All three are fully operational with good patient bases.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Excellent. Are all three locations in the Dallas-Fort Worth area?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Yes, they're all within DFW, which is perfect for consolidation of support services.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Perfect. That's exactly the kind of practice network we work with. Dr. Caldwell, I'd like to get you scheduled for a consultation so we can discuss your specific situation in detail. Would you prefer a meeting next week, or do you have availability later this week?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Next week would be better. Maybe Tuesday or Wednesday afternoon?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Let me check our schedule. I can offer you Tuesday at 3 PM or Wednesday at 2 PM. Which works better for you?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Tuesday at 3 PM is perfect.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Wonderful. I have you down for Tuesday at 3 PM. Just to confirm, your name is Dr. Jennifer Caldwell, correct?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Yes, that's right.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Great. We'll send you a confirmation email with details about the consultation and some information about our valuation process. You'll have a chance to share your practice financials and we'll walk through everything together. Is there anything else I can answer for you today?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: No, I think that covers it. I'm looking forward to it, Marcus.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Excellent, Dr. Caldwell. Thanks so much for calling Apex, and we look forward to speaking with you Tuesday at 3 PM. Take care.

callDetail.aiSummary: Dr. Jennifer Caldwell, a three-location dental practice owner in the Dallas-Fort Worth area, called to explore Apex's partnership model and practice valuation services. During the consultation intake call, Marcus Bell successfully identified her interest in both partnership transition and non-clinical support services, confirmed her geographic fit within Apex's service area, and scheduled a follow-up consultation for Tuesday at 3 PM. However, the agent did not capture her email address or phone number for follow-up, which represents a gap in lead qualification. The call demonstrates strong foundational skills but misses an opportunity to deepen qualification on current operational pain points such as staffing challenges or practice management inefficiencies.

comment.author: Kyle Paklaian
comment.text: @Marcus, great work establishing rapport with Dr. Caldwell and getting the consultation booked. Your qualifying questions about location and practice count were spot on. Going forward, make sure you always capture the email and phone number before closing. You mentioned the confirmation email but never asked for the email itself. Also, consider asking one or two diagnostic questions like 'What's your biggest challenge right now managing all three locations?' to set up the consultation for success and show you understand her world. Nice pacing overall.

transcript.text: Thank you for calling Apex Dental Partners, this is Marcus on the partnership team. How can I help you today?
highlights: Thank you for calling Apex Dental Partners

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Hi Marcus, my name is Dr. Elena Ramirez. I own a two-operatory general practice in Fort Worth and I've been thinking about what my options look like down the road.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: It's great to meet you, Dr. Ramirez. Congratulations on building your own practice. Are you exploring a full transition, or more of a support partnership where you stay on and keep practicing?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Honestly a bit of both. I love treating patients but the back office is burying me. Billing, HR, the IT headaches. I want to keep the private practice feel though.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: That's exactly what our Private Practice Reimagined model is built for. We take over the non-clinical side, HR, marketing, IT, operations, and accounting, while you keep clinical autonomy. Which piece is causing the most pain right now?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: The accounting and insurance billing, for sure. And I've got a hygienist spot I can't fill to save my life.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Good news, both are core services. Our Revenue Cycle and Accounting team centralizes AP, AR, payroll, and insurance billing, and our Talent Acquisition team sources and onboards hygienists and assistants. We'd also handle credentialing across your payers.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Okay, but what does all that run? I want to keep it manageable, I'm not trying to sign away most of my income.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Completely fair. Our model is an ongoing management fee plus an equity buy-in rather than à la carte fees, and the exact number depends on your production. Most partners find it costs less than staffing all those roles in-house. We'd map the real figures for your practice in the valuation.
highlights: management fee plus an equity buy-in

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: See, that's the thing. I'm getting a couple of quotes. There's another group out of Dallas that pitched me last month and their offer felt very corporate.
highlights: I'm getting a couple of quotes

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I hear that a lot. Where we differ is we don't rebrand your office or dictate clinical decisions. You keep your name, your team, your style. We have 50-plus partnered practices across eight states and doctors stay because it still feels like theirs.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: That's reassuring. My one worry is I don't want to be locked in if it isn't the right fit for me and my associate.
highlights: I don't want to be locked in

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: That's why we start with a no-pressure conversation and a free Practice Valuation and Appraisal. You see your fair-market number and the full terms before anything is signed, and you can bring your associate in. Can I get you on a consultation with one of our transition advisors?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Yes, let's do it. Thursday morning works for me.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Perfect, I've scheduled your consultation for Thursday at 10 AM and I'll send confirmation to the email on file. Thanks again, Dr. Ramirez, we look forward to talking.
highlights: scheduled your consultation for Thursday at 10 AM

qaPairs.question: What is a dental support organization?
qaPairs.answer: A DSO like Apex provides non-clinical, administrative support so dentists can focus on patient care while we handle operations, marketing, HR, IT, and accounting. A consultation with our team is the best way to see how the model fits your practice.

qaPairs.question: What is Private Practice Reimagined?
qaPairs.answer: It's our non-branded partnership model that gives supported dentists more personal and professional flexibility while keeping the private-practice feel. I'd be glad to book a consultation so a specialist can explain how it works for you.

qaPairs.question: How does the Apex partnership model work?
qaPairs.answer: We offer a practice-affiliation partnership that combines an ongoing management fee with an equity buy-in and full non-clinical support. Let's schedule a consultation so we can tailor the details to your practice.

qaPairs.question: How much is my dental practice worth?
qaPairs.answer: We establish a fair-market valuation by evaluating your production, collections, and financials, and it's often complimentary for prospective partners. Share a few details and I'll set up a consultation for an exact appraisal.

qaPairs.question: Do you offer a free practice valuation?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, we frequently provide a complimentary fair-market appraisal for practice owners exploring a partnership. I can start that process by booking you a consultation with our team.

qaPairs.question: Which states does Apex operate in?
qaPairs.answer: Apex supports 50+ partnered practices across eight states, with core markets in Texas, Colorado, and Oklahoma. Tell me your practice ZIP code and I'll confirm we serve your area and book a consultation.

qaPairs.question: Will I lose control of my practice if I partner with Apex?
qaPairs.answer: Our model keeps clinical decisions with you while we take on the non-clinical burdens, preserving your private-practice feel. A consultation is the best way to see how much autonomy you retain.

qaPairs.question: What support services does Apex provide?
qaPairs.answer: Our in-house teams cover Operations, Marketing, HR and Recruiting, Finance and Accounting, IT, and Clinical Development. Let's book a consultation so we can map the right support to your practice.

qaPairs.question: How does Apex handle billing and accounting?
qaPairs.answer: All finance and accounting is centralized at our support office, where bills are switched into the Apex name and paid by our accounting department. A consultation can show you how this simplifies your day-to-day.

qaPairs.question: Do you help with insurance credentialing?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, we handle payer enrollment, fee-schedule negotiation, and re-credentialing for your providers. I can set up a consultation to review your credentialing needs.

qaPairs.question: Does Apex help recruit dentists and staff?
qaPairs.answer: Our Talent Acquisition team sources, onboards, and retains dentists, hygienists, and assistants for supported practices. Let's schedule a consultation to discuss your staffing needs.

qaPairs.question: What marketing support do supported practices get?
qaPairs.answer: We provide local SEO, paid ads, website, reputation management, and patient-acquisition campaigns through our in-house marketing team. Book a consultation and we'll outline a plan for your location.

qaPairs.question: Do you offer continuing education?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, we offer AGD-accredited PACE CE courses plus mentorship through our Clinical Leadership Council. A consultation can cover the full clinical development program.

qaPairs.question: What is the Apex Leadership Program?
qaPairs.answer: It's our leadership development program that helped eight practices lift daily production by 24%. I'd be happy to book a consultation so you can learn more.

qaPairs.question: Can I still keep my staff after partnering?
qaPairs.answer: Most partners retain their teams, and we support them with HR, benefits, and professional development. Let's set up a consultation to talk through your team's transition.

qaPairs.question: What benefits does Apex offer team members?
qaPairs.answer: Supported teams can access health insurance, a 401K with company match, short-term disability, and CE reimbursement. A consultation is a great way to review the full benefits picture.

qaPairs.question: How long does a practice transition take?
qaPairs.answer: Timelines vary based on your goals and financials, and your specialist will map out each milestone. Let's book a consultation to build a timeline for your practice.

qaPairs.question: I'm a dentist looking for a job, can you help?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, we recruit for dentist and team member opportunities across our supported practices. I can connect you by scheduling a quick conversation with our talent team.

qaPairs.question: What is the Apex Perspective Podcast?
qaPairs.answer: It's our thought-leadership podcast for the dental community covering practice growth and partnership insights. If you'd like tailored guidance, I can book a consultation for you.

qaPairs.question: How do I get started with Apex?
qaPairs.answer: The best first step is a brief conversation about your goals and practice, followed by answers to your questions about the Apex model. Share your details and I'll schedule that consultation now.

convo.text: Hi there, thanks for calling Apex Dental Partners. I see you were interested in learning about our practice appraisal process. Are you a practice owner looking to explore partnership opportunities or transition options?

That's a great question and exactly what we help practice owners think through. We specialize in fair market valuations and helping dentists understand their options. Do you have a team in place right now, or would managing non-clinical operations like HR, accounting, and marketing be areas where you'd want support?

I handle most of that myself right now, honestly. I'd really benefit from having a marketing team, and frankly, the accounting and HR stuff takes up too much of my time. I want to focus on clinical care, not spreadsheets.

signals.name: Management Fee Objection
signals.rules: voice_signal = any(1, ["the management fee seems high (Caller)", "how much equity do I have to give up (Caller)", "I do not want to lose control of my practice (Caller)", "what percentage do you take (Caller)"])

signals.name: Partnership Interest
signals.rules: voice_signal = any(1, ["I am thinking about partnering my practice (Caller)", "interested in affiliating with Apex (Caller)", "looking for a practice transition partner (Caller)", "we support the non-clinical side of your office (Agent)"])

signals.name: Practice Valuation Requested
signals.rules: voice_signal = any(1, ["how much is my dental practice worth (Caller)", "I would like a practice appraisal (Caller)", "can you value my office (Caller)", "we can establish a fair market valuation (Agent)"])

signals.name: Quote Provided
signals.rules: voice_signal = any(1, ["the ongoing management fee would be around (Agent)", "the monthly rate for managed operations is (Agent)", "our recruiting placement fee runs (Agent)", "here is what the buy-in would look like (Agent)"])
